name: flashidian
description: Your notes are already flashcards: headings, tables, lists and callouts become decks. Review with swipes on your phone, with FSRS. Nothing is written into your notes.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.evals.json --noEmit
scripts.release:check: opdk release check && npm run scorecard:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.capture: npm run build && CAPTURE=1 playwright test e2e/capture.spec.ts --reporter=list && opdk demo

author: Dimagious
